propositions: The predates-gate guard shell idiom is duplicated 24 times across six workflow files with drift risk; two defects (anxious-resistant-urson, sapphire-vulnerable-fruitfly) came from copies diverging
Shared implementations (composite actions, helpers, modules) cannot replace inline guards because they are absent on pre-gate trees that the guard serves
Every gate step must either carry an -f guard for the file it needs with the canonical skip message, or bear a # predates-gate-ok: marker with non-empty reason
Guard steps must exit 0 and print the canonical 'change predates the gate' message when run in an empty directory with ${{ }} expressions substituted

Two genuine gaps were discovered during completeness audit: test.yml steps for readme/probe scripts lack guards while gerrit-verify.yaml guards the same scripts, and _optionality.yml degradation path lacks a guard
A test suite must pin the invariant across all six files to prevent future drift, with negative cases rejecting reasonless markers and dropped guards
